title: annotate.mjs: add note and arrow length to marks (example, commit 64ee8eb)
request: add note and arrow length to annotate marks

requirements.text: A mark can carry an optional text note shown next to its badge
A mark can set its arrow length

decisions.title: Render the note as a red pill beside the badge, one tspan per line
decisions.chosen: SVG rect + text drawn inside the existing overlay; '\n' splits lines into tspans
decisions.why: The overlay is already one SVG; the pill reuses the badge colours so a mark reads as one unit.

alternatives.option: HTML div positioned over the page
alternatives.rejected_because: second layer to measure and clip; the SVG overlay already has extents bookkeeping

decisions.title: Attach the SVG to the document before drawing, not after
decisions.chosen: move document.body.appendChild(svg) above the mark loop
decisions.why: text.getBBox() is needed to size the pill and only measures nodes that are in the DOM.

alternatives.option: estimate text width from character count
alternatives.rejected_because: wrong for proportional fonts and non-Latin text

decisions.title: Flip the pill to the other side and clamp it when it would leave the page
decisions.chosen: flip when it overflows on the arrow side, then clamp x and y into the page
decisions.why: Marks near an edge would otherwise produce a pill cut off in the screenshot.

decisions.title: Grow the mark extent to include the pill
decisions.chosen: minX/minY/maxX/maxY become let and are widened by the pill box
decisions.why: The default crop is computed from mark extents, so a pill outside them would be cropped away.

decisions.title: Optional per-mark length with the old constant as default
decisions.why: Existing specs keep their exact output; only marks that set length change.

alternatives.rejected_because: the request is about marks, and crossing arrows are a per-mark problem

decisions.title: Document note in the spec header and the SKILL.md field table
decisions.chosen: one example mark plus one line in each place
decisions.why: Fields in this script are documented in the header comment and in the SKILL.md table; a field in only one of them goes unnoticed.

decisions.title: Document length in the spec header and the SKILL.md field table
decisions.chosen: one line in each place, with the default value
decisions.why: Same reason as D6; the default (90) is what a reader needs to choose a value.

scenarios.title: A mark with a note gets a pill
scenarios.trigger: node annotate.mjs spec.json, spec has a mark with "note": "32 px → 36 px"
scenarios.input: spec.json with url, out and marks[0] = { selector, note }
scenarios.result: PNG where the badge has a red pill with the note next to it; the crop includes the pill; stdout JSON lists the mark as ok

steps.does: Reads the spec, launches Chromium, opens the page and runs drawOverlay in it with spec.marks.
steps.out: PNG on disk + JSON summary on stdout

steps.does: Builds the SVG overlay and now attaches it to the page before any mark is drawn.
steps.out: { results, width, height } (returned at the end)

edges.case: getBBox() on a detached node would return 0 width

steps.does: For each mark: resolves its box from selector or box, draws outline.
steps.out: box {x, y, width, height} or an ok:false result

steps.does: If mark.note is truthy, builds the pill background and a text node with one tspan per line.
steps.out: bg rect + text nodes in the SVG (not yet positioned)

edges.case: note is only whitespace or newlines
edges.note: draws an empty red pill; nobody checked whether that is wanted

edges.case: note is not a string (number, object)
edges.note: String() coerces; an object renders as [object Object]

steps.does: Measures the text with getBBox and derives the pill size (text width + 20, 20px per line + 10).
steps.in: text node (must be attached to the DOM)

steps.does: Puts the pill on the arrow's side, flips it if it overflows the page edge, then clamps x and y into the page.
steps.in: dx (arrow direction), tailX/tailY, pillW/pillH, page width/height

edges.note: clamp keeps it on the page but it can sit on top of the badge; not looked at
Math.min(…, width - 4 - pillW) goes negative, so the pill starts off-screen and the text is cut; no wrapping or shrinking

steps.does: Writes the computed position and size onto the rect and text.
steps.effects: sets SVG attributes on bg and text

steps.does: Starts the mark extent from outline + badge and widens it to include the pill.
steps.in: outline box, badge position, pill box
steps.out: extent {minX, minY, maxX, maxY} pushed to results (line 160)

edges.case: default crop must contain the pill

steps.does: Returns the results; the late appendChild that used to sit here is gone (moved to S1.2).

edges.note: main prints the failures and exits 1; the SVG is attached either way

scenarios.title: A mark with a length gets a longer arrow
scenarios.trigger: node annotate.mjs spec.json, spec has a mark with "length": 140
scenarios.result: arrow from the outline corner is 140 px long instead of 90, kept inside the page

steps.does: Same entry as S1.1: reads the spec and runs drawOverlay with spec.marks.
Picks mark.length or the default 90 and places the arrow tail that far from the tip, clamped 16 px inside the page.
steps.in: mark.length (number, optional), tip position, direction dx/dy

edges.note: falls back to ARROW, output identical to before

edges.case: length longer than the space to the page edge

edges.note: || treats 0 as unset, so the arrow gets 90; probably fine, but it is a silent surprise
NaN reaches setAttribute; the arrow is not drawn and nothing reports it
